reader.title: Maximum Cycle Cover under the k × k Clique Hypothesis

sourceBasis.step: The Cycle Packing lower bound under this hypothesis combines with the reduction in Lemma C.22. The reduction attaches a private three-vertex path and its closing edges at each vertex. A spanning cycle cover uses either a private triangle or a private four-cycle through the attachment vertex. The threshold increases by the original number of vertices, the complete output size grows polynomially, and the supplied width increases by at most three.
